_comment: Lighthouse CI GATE, desktop (mobile: .lighthouserc.mobile.json; workflow: .github/workflows/lighthouse.yml). staticDistDir makes lhci serve apps/web/out itself (gzip on, no _headers); URLs resolve against http://localhost:<random-port>/. Keep the staticDistDir literal and the four legacy URL literals (/, /iclr-2026/, /iclr-2026/lineage/, /themes/) exactly once each: apps/pipeline's dataMove rollback (release/dataMove/lighthouseEdit.ts) rewrites them. Tighten budgets as fixes ship; loosen one only with a measured reason in the PR.

settings._disable_comment: Skip lighthouse-plugin-publisher-ads and the PWA category — neither applies to this static site, and lighthouse logs ugly warnings if they're left enabled.

assert._budget_comment: Measured 2026-10-12 with lhci 0.15 on the built site (3 runs, min-max): / perf 1.00, LCP 0.57-0.64 s, TBT 0, CLS 0.024, JS 138 KB, fonts 148 KB; /themes/ perf 0.99, LCP 0.86-0.89 s, CLS 0.004, JS 181 KB, fonts 233 KB; /iclr-2026/ perf 0.91, LCP 1.94-1.97 s, CLS 0.010, fonts 298 KB; /icml-2026/ perf 1.00, LCP 0.48-0.65 s, CLS 0.010; /iclr-2026/lineage/ perf 1.00, SEO 0.63; /icml-2026/paper-links/ perf 1.00, 0 scripts, SEO 0.60. Budgets: perf = measured minus 0.1-0.15 (catalogs: 0.8); LCP <= 2.5 s (catalogs 3 s); TBT <= 300 ms; CLS <= 0.1 everywhere (was 0.14-0.33 before the 2026-10-12 fixes); a11y and best-practices >= 0.95 (measured 1.00); SEO >= 0.95, except /lineage/ and /paper-links/ which are noindex BY DESIGN (is-crawlable fails -> 0.6); JS +20% (landing 165 KB, others 220 KB); fonts <= 330 KB, landing <= 180 KB (was 284 KB before the unicode-range fix); paper-links must stay script-free. Lighthouse's default aggregation applies (the best of the 3 runs per URL), so one noisy run does not fail the gate; a real regression shows in every run.
